citation: Singh G, Orman MA, Conrad JC, Nikolaou M. Systematic design of pulse dosing to eradicate persister bacteria. PLoS Comput Biol. 2023;19(1):e1010243.

contents: Article PDF (18 pp) and S1 Text (Appendices A-D: derivation of the t_off/t_on criterion, optimal decline rate, estimation of K_n,off and K_n,on from Fig 5, analytical solution of the two-state ODEs). The article's own numeric data are NOT here: the authors put them on GitHub, fetched separately to ../_fetched/singh2023/ because that repository carries no licence.
why: A second, independent two-state persister model (normal/persister with switching rates a, b and net rates K_n, K_p) fitted to E. coli / ampicillin time-kill data, for comparison against the model under audit. Fitted parameters are in Table 1; underlying data are E. coli WT (pQE-80L GFP) under ampicillin 100 ug/mL.
